Original plan & assumptions

Use whole days, 1–10 for each duration. All days are elapsed from Day 0.

Plan order: a 1-day Brief starts Delivery and Preparation in parallel. Assembly waits for both, then a 1-day Review completes the plan.

Recovery limits: expediting removes up to 2 days of added delivery delay. Help shortens Assembly by 1 day, with at least 1 day remaining. Original delivery time is preserved.
